judged_text: The credential DB-fetch copied into handleCancelBooking omits the `app: { select: { slug: true } }` include and the appName remapping that the identical blocks in EventManager perform, handing getCalendar a credential with no appName. Cancelling a collective booking whose calendar reference points at a teammate's credential (never present in bookingToDelete.user.credentials) fetches a credential that cannot be resolved to an integration the way the EventManager copies arrange, so `calendar?.deleteEvent` silently no-ops and the teammate's calendar keeps the cancelled event.

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `handleCancelBooking` now falls back to `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })` and then passes that raw credential to `getCalendar(...)`. Unlike the newly-added DB-fetch blocks in `EventManager` (e.g. `createAllCalendarEvents` / `updateBooking`), it does not `include: { app: { select: { slug: true }}}` nor remap into a `CredentialWithAppName` shape with `appName: credentialFromDB.app.slug`. This inconsistency is verifiable in the diff and could plausibly affect integration resolution when the credential isn’t already in `bookingToDelete.user.credentials`, but the diff alone doesn’t prove that `getCalendar` requires `appName` (or that `deleteEvent` will silently no-op) in this codepath.
